comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/NullxException please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

replies.author: NullxException
replies.body: Updated but I don't have any special setup it's pure vibe coded game

comments.author: aj_marshall
comments.body:
Can you explain your dev process a bit? How did you actually structure automation systems in the gameplay loop? How long did this take to reach current state?

Great disclaimer BTW.

replies.author: NullxException
replies.body:
3 days most of what you see here already worked with multiplayer, i been spending some time polishing and trying to think of new ideas.

The automation i just asked AI to do it, I have no idea how the code looks. My unity scene is legit one gameobject and everything spawns runtime, I don't do any manual work, 100% vibe coding -> playtesting -> vibe coding. I just describe what i want and it makes it.

The idea started around 23 october (moon sweeper inspired this game) but I couldn't do much work on it until start of november(was busy) and by the 5th nov i submited the game for review.

  
happy to take suggestions on what to add :)

replies.author: EastPlant1079
replies.body:
Bro, the anti-AI crowd have nothing to do with morality. The pro AI people have constantly worked to improve safety, true safety, not fake bullshit safety, for all models and AI projects. We have deliberately made ecosystems where nobody is harmed, or are harmed considerably less in real life. 

If we can build games without using and exploiting people, then it's a good thing. A positive development. I literally saw someone who spent 50k on a mediocre, ugly looking game made by humans vs 700 dollars for something that looked beautiful and wholesome by comparison with Claude. 

The people giving jobs are also being exploited by the people offering their work. Imagine performing at half the speed of the competition and still being allowed to work in the job. That's an issue with many companies.
